aj3825.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.
s: Name as indexed in a chain
as: Trustworthy, a mukhaḍram who lived across the pre-Islamic and Islamic periods.
من أعلم أهل الكوفة بحديث عبد الله؟ قال: أبو وائل.
Abū ʿUbaydah identified Abū Wāʾil as the Kufan most knowledgeable about ʿAbd Allāh’s hadith.
عليك بشقيق فاني أدركت الناس وهم متوافرون وانهم ليعدونه من خيارهم.
Study with Shaqīq. I met the people when they were still numerous, and they counted him among their best.
He is better than I am.
عاصم بن بهدلة, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما سمعت أبا وائل سب إنسانا قط ولا بهيمة.
I never heard Abū Wāʾil insult a person or an animal.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
He is trustworthy. There is no need to ask about someone like him.
He was trustworthy and prolific in hadith.
لأبي عبيدة, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
من أعلم الناس بحديث أبيك؟ قال: أبو وائل.
Abū ʿUbaydah identified Abū Wāʾil as the person most knowledgeable about his father’s hadith.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī
His reports from Abū Bakr are mursal.

t2869.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Ṣāliḥ ibn Ṣāliḥ al-Asadī, acceptable, also of the seventh generation, noting that confusing him with the previous one is an error.

t2977.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. Makhlad al-Shaybānī, Abū ʿĀṣim al-Nabīl al-Baṣrī, as trustworthy and firm, of the ninth generation, who died in 212 AH.
as: Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ثقة، كثير الحديث، وكان له فقه
Reliable and prolific in hadith, with knowledge of jurisprudence.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
صدوق، وهو أحب إلي من روح بن عبادة
Truthful. I prefer him to Rawḥ ibn ʿUbādah.
عمر بن شبة, quoted by al-Mizzī
حدثنا أبو عاصم النبيل، والله ما رأيت مثله
Abū ʿĀṣim al-Nabīl transmitted to us. By God, I saw no one like him.
وما دلست حديثا قط، وإني لأرجم من يدلس
I never used tadlīs in a hadith, and I condemn whoever uses it.
He was reliable and a jurist.
He was never seen using a book.
الخليل بن عبد الله الخليلي القزويني, quoted by al-Mizzī
متفق عليه زهدا، وعلما، وديانة، وإتقانا
There is agreement on his renunciation, learning, piety and precision.
كان يحفظ قدر ألف حديث. من جيد حديثه، وكان فيه مزاح
He memorized around a thousand of his good reports and had a playful streak.
إبراهيم بن يحيى, quoted by al-Mizzī
إذا قلنا حدثنا أبو عاصم، فليس أحد يرد علينا
When we say 'Abu Asim told us', no one rejects it from us.
He was reliable and a jurist.
